description: This file defines interfaces for the Analytics Backend component, including the IAnalyticsBackend and IAnalyticsBackendAdministrator interfaces within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares structures, constants, and type definitions related to analytics event handling and backend management.

classes.name: IAnalyticsBackend
classes.description: Interface for the Analytics Backend, defining methods for configuration and sending events, as well as the Event structure containing event details.

classes.name: IAnalyticsBackendAdministrator
classes.description: Interface providing a static method to create backend instances, and a virtual destructor.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics backend with a given shell and system time.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an analytics event to the backend.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of analytics backend instances.
